title: Bynk canary registry
description: The repositories the org-wide canary re-runs against new Bynk releases. Each `repo` must be unique; CI checks that too, since JSON Schema's uniqueItems compares whole entries.

kind.description: `example`: a Bynk example project (read by the examples index and the compat board). `action`: one of the org's GitHub Actions. `book`: a book whose listings are compiled against Bynk.

description.description: One line describing the repository. Required: the examples index shows it, and Bynk decodes a plain optional string only as a required field (accuser/bynk#1887).
